gv_the_lip.accept_text:
You came down the pass from the Sands, so you have already seen what a hole in limestone looks like when the water has gone. Walk north to the Dry Rim, the edge of this one, and look at what it looks like when the water has NOT.

There is green down there. Four days in any direction from here there is no green at all.

gv_the_seam_is_the_zone.accept_text:
Here is a thing nobody tells newcomers and everybody works out: you can see the seams from the top. They are the only lit thing in the hole.

Stand on the rim, pick one, and follow it all the way down. Everybody who works this wall knows their own seam by sight and that is how you start.

There is a seam running down north-east of my bench and another to the south-west. Either will do. Both is better.

gv_the_other_two_pumps.description: Pumps. Two of them work, and they are not the Company's two.

gv_mv_still_on_shift.turn_in_text:
I will do the rest myself over time.

Hesper Dunn keeps a book like mine out in the port and she told me once she keeps hers so that in four years nobody can claim the town was always like this. Mine is so that in four years somebody can still say their names.
